expressions.cn: 你能帮我吗？ (Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma?)
不好意思 / 对不起 (Bù hǎoyìsi / Duìbuqǐ)
你能再说一遍吗？ (Nǐ néng zài shuō yī biàn ma?)
好的 / 明白了 (Hǎo de / Míngbái le)

work.scenario: You're working on a presentation, need a colleague's input, accidentally interrupt your boss, and confirm new instructions.
key_phrases: Boleh anda bantu saya siapkan slaid ini?
Maafkan saya, boleh anda ulang semula arahan tadi?
Terima kasih banyak-banyak atas bantuan anda.

life.scenario: You're at a grocery store, accidentally bump into someone, ask for help finding an item, and ask if you can use a specific payment method.
key_phrases: Boleh tolong saya cari sos cili?
Boleh tak saya bayar guna e-wallet?

tech.scenario: Your internet is down, you call technical support, need them to repeat a step, and confirm the troubleshooting instructions.
key_phrases: Boleh anda bantu saya selesaikan masalah internet?
Maaf, boleh ulang balik langkah yang ketiga tadi?
